'''''Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse''''' by [[Troy Denning]] is the ninth and final novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. It was released on [[March 13]], [[2012]]. At the end of the book, it has an introduction to ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' and [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]. The audio version is narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The paperback edition was released on [[January 29]], [[2013]].
